comparator.name: Sociology (Sociologie)
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted regulations and catalogue support 138 EC of fixed compulsory work, 12 EC of restricted electives and 30 EC of open study. The example selects the first eligible item from each restricted menu. The 18 EC individual thesis requires 90 EC from years one and two plus participation in intervention evaluation. The Dutch language assessment is integrated with Project 1 and mentoring has no additional credits.

alternatives.label: Sociology, inequality and social research
alternatives.labelReason: Names actual sociological core and companion methods/context withoutcompleteprofessional orspecialist equivalence.
alternatives.concept: Sociological theory, qualitative enquiry and quantitative methods anchor this programme. Political science, public economics, history and psychology add perspectives on inequality and social change. Community work and negotiation contribute applied skills, with less specialist inequality, co-creative research and partner-facing intervention training than VU.
progression: All courses are planned in their assigned terms. Personal & Professional Development is in Year 1. Formal prerequisite order: BENGATE102 (term 2) before BENLEAD312 (term 4); BENGATE102 (term 2) before BENECON311 (term 4); HCBGATE102 (term 1) before HCBPSYC314 (term 4); BENGATE102 (term 2) before BENLEAD311 (term 5); BENGATE102 (term 2) before BENECON312 (term 6); BENGATE102 (term 2) before BENLEAD211 (term 6).

alternatives.label: Sociology with digital methods and media analysis
alternatives.labelReason: Names actual sociological core and companion methods/context withoutcompleteprofessional orspecialist equivalence.
alternatives.concept: Sociological theory and social research are paired with data analysis, machine learning, media studies and AI ethics. The programme examines how media and automated decisions shape social life. UCR develops relevant analytical tools and studies algorithmic fairness, while VU provides dedicated network analysis and a sequence of partner projects.
progression: All courses are planned in their assigned terms. Personal & Professional Development is in Year 1. Formal prerequisite order: BENGATE102 (term 2) before BENECON312 (term 6); DISGATE102 (term 2) before DISDATA311 (term 6).

Sociology, Social Entrepreneurship and Consultancy Practice
candidates.assessment: A project-intensive programme would give disproportionate weight to business and leadership. UCR community engagement and qualitative research are useful, but do not form a sequence of commissioned sociological inquiry, intervention and consultancy.

selection.assessment: The two options share five sociology courses and a social-research sequence. The broader route develops inequality and institutions through politics, economics, history and psychology. The digital route adds text data, algorithms, media and AI ethics. A project-intensive route was reconsidered, but the available business and leadership courses do not support VU’s sustained sociological work with partners.

notes.text: Both UCR options include sociological theory and empirical methods. VU additionally teaches dedicated network analysis, co-creative research and intervention evaluation, and requires an individual 18 EC thesis.

VU integrates four compulsory projects with societal partners. UCR’s community work, economics and communication courses provide related experiences with a different structure. Optional independent research is outside the scheduled 180 EC.

audience.programmeDescription: VU’s Dutch-taught Sociology degree studies inequality, diversity and digital society. Students learn qualitative and quantitative research and work with societal partners through four projects in policy, research, social entrepreneurship and consultancy. They also learn to evaluate interventions and complete an individual thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: Two UCR options build on sociological theory and social research. One adds politics, economics and history to study inequality. The other combines data analysis, media studies and AI ethics to study digital society. VU provides more specialist training in network analysis, research with community partners and intervention evaluation.

curriculum.limitation: This 180 EC example includes two restricted electives and 30 EC of open study. The 18 EC thesis requires 90 EC from the first two years and participation in intervention evaluation.
